author: TheLastNail
text:
Student: Hi IF,

Could you throw in one chart example demostrating this quote of yours please.

"In essence, we know that if price engulfs South, it wants to move down to the last engulf North."

Would appreciate this thankyou

Alex

____________________

I just read the request and went straight to the charts to draw up the answer.

Suddenly an alarm started ringing in my mind, and I was reminded of a
chat I had the other day with a couple of my oldest trading friends. I
had mentioned a concept, and one of them asked me to explain it. I knew
full well that I had explained it before, so was taken aback to be asked
 about it as if it were a brand new idea.

It was an extremely important lesson, and one I thought would've been instinctive to everyone by now.

I got to thinking again that a lesson served up on a silver platter in a free website may indeed have little perceived value

So, before I answer this request, I want you guys to work it out as best you can.

In doing it, I want you to consider:

Flags/Poles

FTR (actualy the same as above)

Support/Resistance breaks (I hope you noticed by now that FTR is the precise science of this!)

PAZ (Same thing again!)

If you can tie all of these things together with the engulf, you have
the unified theory of market dynamics, and you'll be astonished at how
simple the market is to read. You'll actually be able to boil it down
to; If X, then Y

__________________________

This might be one of the most important quotes that is missing in than quotes list.

author: Ifmyante
text:
I've been learning of more and more RTM franchises being started up
all over the planet, who seem to be making a great living selling what
I've given away for free!

Well, I've been convinced to jump on that band wagon, and am in the
middle of creating a couple of courses to put on the market too.

As you know, I love to pick tops and bottoms for my trades. That's just
my style. But there are ways of making a great living by simply ticking
off certain checklists for a trade in the right place.

What I've decided to do is teach exactly how to take these trades in a
very methodical fashion; where to enter, where to place stops, and where
 to take profit.

These courses will be far less expensive than the academy, but almost as valuable.

The academy graduates need not fear the orders of the new students,
because they know how to get in at the tops and bottoms, long before the
 new crew enter.

Having said that, clever new students will be able to take entries with little or no drawdown too.

In RTM, I've mostly focused on reading the market rather than trading it. Here's where that changes!

So, look out for banners on this site in a little while, which will explain more about what I'm doing
